test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman, Amit and Anil are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sunil is to the immediate left of Ram. Ram is fourth to the left of Rahul. Amit is fourth to the right of raj. Raj is second to the right of Ram. Anil is second to the left of Sumit. Aman is second to the right of Sumit. Who is second to the right of Sunil?
solution:
Eight boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman, Amit and Anil are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Sunil is to the immediate left of Ram and Ram is fourth to the left of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35f2433538f83cb5e82f6e5e056815a0c0cfc84c224ac98c04d074edc8c6aeee.png] 

2) Raj is second to the right of Ram and Amit is fourth to the right of raj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66cd881e78ad10c0a4313833999574aeb6991f41871089312a0f959aa9e10f9e.png] 

3) Anil is second to the left of Sumit and Aman is second to the right of Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5663adf8f88ad984c5766c336ce0d0319208f796160868b4cccd6e86aebf9aec.png] 

∴ Here, 'Anil' is second to the right of Sunil.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Anil".**
